title: 2026-27 Fine Arts Fee Schedule: Ensemble Rates for Band, Orchestra and Theatre (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**Fine Arts Department, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees — scheduled ensemble rate.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the 2026-27 Fine Arts fee schedule sets the scheduled ensemble rate at 75.00 for band or orchestra when the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 06 or above, at 50.00 for theatre when that record shows grade 09 or above, and otherwise at the Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation fee of the activity fee catalogue (60.00). The enrollment record is the one Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions keeps for the student and school year.

| Ensemble | Grade on the enrollment record in status enrolled | Scheduled ensemble rate |
|---|---|---|
| band | 06 through 12 | 75.00 |
| orchestra | 06 through 12 | 75.00 |
| theatre | 09 through 12 | 50.00 |
| theatre | 06 through 08 | 60.00, the catalogue participation fee |
| choir | any | 60.00, the catalogue participation fee |
| any | no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | 60.00, the catalogue participation fee |

**Points of judgement.** Band and orchestra share one rate. Theatre turns at grade 09: a grade 08 theatre student takes the catalogue fee and a grade 09 student 50.00. Choir has no rate of its own in this schedule.
